added_failures_note: derived from the reviewed run's own arm logs on disk: gate-base.log at 73a771c records 81 passed EXIT=0 with no FAILED line and gate-after.log at c70293a6 records 83 passed EXIT=0 with no FAILED line, so the set difference is empty (0).

0.reason: the dropped 1,724 MB/min head window had no surviving raw log (the prior review's finding 5); the RCA keeps only windows whose receipts exist, and the live bound is s88's measure now.

1.reason: the 60 s live window and its bound are carried by s88, which measures them after its cache change; this node lands as a partial.

2.reason: this node lands as a partial: the dominant 42.7% _cached_stream_entry reader is s88's deliverable.

findings.text: non-blocking: the final record reports two live windows and drops the 1,724 MB/min 145 s head window that commit 5d61bd888a had recorded, so the worse of the run's own head measurements leaves the research document in a commit whose stated purpose was the sample size and the test labels.
non-blocking: the census was taken over 40 s where the done_when names one 60 s window, so the recorded census does not match the window the measure states.

non-blocking: the change removes the census's second-largest reader and leaves its dominant one, _cached_stream_entry at 42.7 %, named as residual, so the goal sentence's dominant read is not the read this node removed.
non-blocking: the 4096-cursor eviction bound has no assertion anywhere, so a change back to clearing the whole store, which the commit message claims to replace, would pass every test in the gate.

non-blocking: the resume trusts only the shared 8 KiB opening sample, so an in-place rewrite that keeps the opening and changes bytes before the held offset is answered from the cursor, which is the same bound the parsed-stream cache accepts but is now reachable from a second reader.
non-blocking: the fragment records the live bound as unmet by this change, so the node's own deliverable carries a done_when clause the section must still close.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit from 73a771c to c70293a6; 77100cbd43 replaces the whole-stream scan with a cursor, 157e612e11 routes the rewrite check through _backends.stream_head_fingerprint and _stream_head_intact and drops the duplicated sample, 3d28583c0c adds and then loses the plain-mapping tolerance, 622fd58737 adds the count flag to _backends._stream_lines_from, and c70293a6b8 adds the in-place-rewrite case.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when's census, fixture, verdict-equality, matched-arm and ruff clauses are all measured and recorded, but the live clause (under 20 MB/min and under 5 % of one core over 60 s after the first tick) is recorded unmet at docs/research/monitor-storage-load-rca.html:511-530 with the head window at 1,376 MB/min and 75.4 % of one core against the base window's 1,131 MB/min and 92.5 %.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is to remove the dominant read a per-path census of the station names; the census at docs/research/monitor-storage-load-rca.html:460 names _backends._cached_stream_entry at 42.7 % and recovery_memo._newest_result_event at 19.5 %, and the landed cursor in reckon/crew/recovery_memo.py:741 removes the second, leaving the census's dominant reader named as residual rather than removed.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records status complete, the eight commits, arm gates of 81 passed at base and 83 passed at head with EXIT=0, the negative control and the head-check reversal at EXIT=1, matched-importer arms failing the same single pre-existing id at both revisions, and four ruff logs whose findings are identical either side, and each of those logs was opened and matches what the manifest states.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the declared paths; the eight node commits touch only reckon/crew/recovery_memo.py, reckon/_backends.py, tests/test_the_station_reads_only_what_changed.py, tests/test_a_lane_signal_reads_a_stream_once.py, docs/research/monitor-storage-load-rca.html and the evidence fragment, all inside the fence, and the 365-path delivered range is the run's own merge of main at dc8a209001 rather than authored work.

justifications.durability: tests/test_the_station_reads_only_what_changed.py:1108 and the negative control at logs/negative-control.log redden on a restored whole-stream read, and tests/test_a_lane_signal_reads_a_stream_once.py:62 reddens if the identity short-circuit is removed.
justifications.evidence: docs/research/monitor-storage-load-rca.html:511-530 records the live window as 1,376 MB/min and 75.4 % of one core against a 20 MB/min and 5 % bound, so the done_when's headline clause is measured and recorded unmet rather than asserted.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/recovery_memo.py:723 keeps the module's per-process memo idiom and its bounded store, and the staged paths add no ruff finding against base as logs/ruff-check-head.log records.
justifications.goal_fidelity: docs/research/monitor-storage-load-rca.html:460 names _cached_stream_entry at 42.7 % as dominant while the cursor changes _newest_result_event at 19.5 %, and no census at the delivered head shows the dominant read gone.
justifications.reuse: reckon/crew/recovery_memo.py:768 and :777 read through _backends._stream_head_intact and _stream_lines_from rather than the private 256-byte sample the first commit added.
justifications.scope_discipline: every one of the eight authored commits touches only a declared path, and the merge dc8a209001 contributes main's work rather than this node's.
